trace · A little more clarity.
OUR APPROACH

Patterns, not proof.

Trace v1 uses simple, transparent rules in your browser. It is an exploratory text-review prototype, not a validated AI classifier. It cannot establish whether text was generated by AI.

What we measure

  • Variation in sentence word counts (coefficient of variation).
  • Repeated first-three-word sentence openings.
  • A fixed list of stock transition phrases.
  • Explicit assistant-style phrases, which may also appear in quotations.

Each rule counts as one signal when triggered. The total is not a probability or an accuracy score. The thresholds are design choices, not statistically validated detection thresholds.

Where it falls short

Short samples, formal writing, edited or translated text, and writing by English learners can be misleading. Rules and phrase lists are English-focused. AI-generated text can show no signals; human writing can trigger every signal. Images, audio, video, and PDFs are not supported in this version.

Review responsibly

Use drafts, version history, original sources, and a conversation with the author to assess provenance. Never use these results alone for disciplinary, hiring, or academic decisions.

Read OpenAI’s account of classifier limitations ↗

No external model, API, analytics, or text storage is used. Downloaded reports are saved only when you request them.
